nodes.name: 0f. Count Today's Submits
nodes.notes: HG-2: this client's records locked or submitted to HeyGen today (client timezone). Counted against Daily_Video_Cap.

nodes.name: 0g. Attach Daily Count
nodes.notes: HG-2: adds submitted_today to the client config. If the count failed, submitted_today is null and nothing is submitted for this client in this run.

nodes.name: 3g. Re-read Record Live
nodes.notes: HG-2: reads each record again right before submit.

nodes.name: 3i. Gate - Live State + Daily Cap
nodes.notes: HG-2: a record is submitted only if it is still Ready for Video Generation with an empty HeyGen_Video_ID and the client is under Daily_Video_Cap.

nodes.name: 3k. Lock Record (Video Processing)
nodes.notes: HG-2: the lock. Status leaves Ready BEFORE the HeyGen call so no other run can pick the record up. If this write fails the run stops and nothing is submitted.

parameters.jsCode: return { json: { ...$('3i. Gate - Live State + Daily Cap').item.json } };

nodes.name: 3m. Cap Reached - Write Note
nodes.notes: HG-2: over the daily cap. Status is left at Ready for Video Generation; only the note is written.

nodes.name: 4x. Error - HeyGen Submit Failed
nodes.notes: HG-2: submit returned no video_id. Status = Failed with the HeyGen error in Reel_Notes. A Failed record with no HeyGen ID does not count against the daily cap.

nodes.name: 3j. Gate Route
nodes.notes: 0 = daily cap reached (write note, stay Ready), 1 = skip (nothing written), 2 = submit. Cap and skip come first so their notes are written before the submit branch waits.

nodes.name: 5a. Submit Failed?
nodes.notes: HG-2: true = HeyGen returned no video_id. The failed branch is output 0 so it is written straight away, before the success branch reaches the 10-minute wait. Never leave an empty ID on Video Processing.

nodes.name: 3n. Not Approved - Back to Verified
nodes.notes: T-44: Production_Approval not ticked or Script_Approval not Approved. Nothing is sent to HeyGen; Status returns to Verified so the record is not picked up again.
